paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul sih nung in Amalekte zou khin David ahong kik nawn a, Ziklag ah David ni nih a-om hi.
heading: David In Saul Sih Thu Athei
english: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni in, ngai in, mi khat Saul panmun a kipan apuante bohkeksa leh alu a lei kai niaunuau in ahong pai hi.
english: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.

paite: David kiang ahong tun in lei a bokkhup in zahtakna apia hi. David in akiang ah, "Koi a pan hong pai na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Israel mite panmun a pan hong taikhia ka hi," achi hi.
english: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”

paite: David in akiang ah, "Bangchibang in thil a-om a? Hon hilh dih ve," achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kidouna a pan mite ataikek ua, mi tampi puk in asi uh. Saul leh atapa Jonathan leng asi tuaktuak uh," achi hi.
english: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”

paite: David in amah hilhpa tangval kiang ah, "Bangchi in ahia Saul leh atapa Jonathan asih uh na theih?" achi hi.
english: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”

paite: Ahilhpa tangval in, "Bangchi chi hiam in Gilboa tang ah ka na om kha zenzen hi. Ngai in, ateipi ngai a Saul dingh ka mu a, kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite'n hon naihta uhi.
english: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.

paite: Anunglam angatleh ahon mu a, hon sam hi. Ke'n, 'Hiai ah ka om,' chi in ka dawng hi.
english: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’

paite: Ka kiang ah, 'Kua na hia?' ahon chi hi. Ke'n, Amalek mi ka hi, chi in ka dawng hi.
english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, 'Ka kiang ah hong dingh inla hong that mai dih, ka hing lai vanglak a, lungdonna in lah hon manta ngal a,' achi hi.
english: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’

paite: Akiang ah ka dingh a, huchi a pukgawp khinsa, damzou nawn lou ding chih ka theih ziak in ka thatta mai hi. Alu a lallukhu leh aban a tau ka la a, ka pu kiang ah ka hon tawi hi,” achi hi.
english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”

paite: David in apuansilhte abotkekta a, huchi mah bang in akiang a mi om tengteng in leng ahih uhi.
english: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.

paite: Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh TOUPA mite leh Israel inkuante asuun ua, akah ua, nitaklam tan in an angawl ua, namsau a thah ahih ziakun.
english: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

paite: David in amah va hilhtu tangval kiang ah, "Koilam mi na hia?" achi hi.
english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”

paite: Ama'n, "Gamdangmi, Amalek mi tapa ka hi," chi in adawng hi. David in akiang ah, "TOUPA thaunilh hihmang dia atung a khut khak bangchidan a lau lou na hia le?" achi hi.
english: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”

paite: David in tangval khat asam a, "Va naih inla, that in," achi a, ama'n ava sat a, asita hi.
english: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.

paite: David in akiang ah, "Na sisan nangmah lutung ah om hen. Nangmah kam ngei in, TOUPA thaunilh ka that ahi, chi a na puan tak man in," achi hi.
english: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain Yahweh’s anointed.’”

paite: David in Saul leh atapa Jonathan hiai kahtam in asuun hi:
heading: David In Saul Leh Jonathan Akah
english: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

paite: Thalkapdan Judah suante sinsak ding in asawl a, ngai in, Jasher laibu ah hiai gelh ahi:
english: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

paite: Aw Israel, na kilawmna mun sangte ah athat ua, na mihatte apukta uh.
english: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!

paite: Gath ah gen kei unla, Ashkelon kongzingte ah puang kei un. Huchi lou in zaw Philistia tanute akipak ding ua, Ezeksum louh tanute avualzou kha ding uhi.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

paite: Nou Gilboa tangte aw, na tung uah daitui leh vuah ke kei hen. Thillat dingte leng suah sam ke'n. Huai ah lah mihat lum Saul lum, thaunilh louh mi lum bang mai in giloutak in apaimang uhi.
english: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.

paite: Thah a omte sisan a pan leh mihat thau a pan Jonathan thal akik nawn kei a, Saul namsau avuak in akik nawn kei hi.
english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.

paite: Saul leh Jonathan hindan adeihhuai in akilawm a, asih un leng akikhen kei uh. Mupite sang in ahatzaw ua, humpinelkaite sang in ahatzaw uhi.
english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.

paite: Nou Israel tanute aw, Saul kah un, puansan kilawmte na tung uah abaang a, na puan uah dangka-eng a zephoihnate hon koihsakpa ahi.
english: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.

paite: Kidou laitak a mihatte apuk maizen uh! Aw, Jonathan, na mun sangte ah nang ahon thatta uhi.
english: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.

paite: Ka unaupa Jonathan, na tungthu ah ka lungzing petmah hi. Ka tung ah na hoih mahmah a, N'on itna alamdang a, numei itna akhup hi.
english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.

paite: Mihatte apuk ua, kidouna galvante leng amangthang khinta!
english: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”
